sources.title: Foundations of Generative AI Models - Coursera
sources.snippet: Explore how Generative AI models are trained, evaluated, and enhanced using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Learn the key steps in model training, techniques to assess model quality, and understand how RAG improves output accuracy by combining retrieval and generation. Discover emerging trends shaping the future of GenAI and gain insights into evolving industry applications.
